rows.angle: HALEU enrichment — fuel for advanced reactors

bear_case.title: The Senate proved the House vote was theater
bear_case.description: Oklo and NuScale popped 13% and 10% intraday when the House passed the Ratepayer Protection Act 417-3 on Sep 16 — then a Senate Democrat blocked the same bill from advancing days later. The legislative path that was supposed to validate the data-center-power thesis is now stalled entirely, not just slow.

bear_case.title: TVA's "weeks" have turned into three weeks and counting
bear_case.description: TVA said on Sep 9 that an NRC construction-permit decision on Clinch River was expected "within weeks." Nineteen days later the NRC has only opened a hearing-request window on the application — the same incremental-procedural pattern that has defined SMR permitting for a decade, even for the country's most advanced project. Counter: TVA and the NRC have not walked back the underlying timeline, and a hearing-request window is a normal procedural step rather than a rejection.

bear_case.title: Zero operating SMRs, and the flagship deal is still a framework
bear_case.description: NuScale's own leadership is now pointing investors to a TVA power purchase agreement it merely hopes to sign by year-end 2026 — an implicit admission that the headline 6GW TVA/ENTRA1 program has not produced a single priced, binding contract more than a year after it was announced. Counter: a year-end signing target is a specific, dated commitment from management, not an open-ended one, and gives the market a concrete date to hold them to.

bear_case.title: Even the sector's counter-argument is getting harder to price
bear_case.description: Westinghouse's prospective IPO is the single largest embedded-value catalyst in the group, yet analyst enterprise-value estimates now span from roughly $22-31B (Desjardins, this week) to Bloomberg's $50B+ figure from two weeks ago, with the IPO window itself seen stretching out as far as 2029 — a widening, not narrowing, range of uncertainty on the asset carrying the most weight in the bull case.
